description: Read the speech-to-text transcript started by transcriptlab_transcribe_file (pass upload_id) or transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url (pass media_id). Pass exactly one id. While transcription runs it returns a pending result: wait a few seconds, back off, and stop after about ten tries; if it is still pending, tell the user the job is queued instead of looping. Pass the same lang, tier, and diarize selectors used when starting transcription so the read selects the matching artifact. Reading does not start new work. Upload reads and reads by the producing account are free; media transcript reads by another account can cost 1 credit per delivery.

diarize.description: Must match the original transcription; implies the premium artifact.

engine.description: Media reads only: must match the engine passed to transcriptlab_transcribe_media_url, if any; defaults to auto.

lang.description: Must match the lang hint passed when starting transcription, if any.

tier.description: Must match the tier passed when starting transcription, if any.

name: transcriptlab_get_speech_transcript
title: Read a speech-to-text transcript
